name: Sanctum

requiredConfig.name: SANCTUM_API_KEY
requiredConfig.description: Sanctum API key. Required for live LST reads, Token Swap quotes, and prepared actions. Must never be persisted in receipts, prepared-action params, notes, warnings, or browser state.

requiredConfig.name: SANCTUM_API_BASE_URL
requiredConfig.description: Override the Sanctum API base URL. Defaults to https://sanctum-api.ironforge.network.

requiredConfig.name: SANCTUM_CONNECTOR_ENABLED
requiredConfig.description: Optional feature flag. Values false, 0, or off disable the connector.

readCapabilities.returns: Sanctum LST catalog metadata, including mint, symbol, decimals, disabled status, and validator or pool metadata where the API exposes it.
One Sanctum LST metadata snapshot by mint or symbol, with optional APY rows.
Infinity pool metadata, INF mint, known Sanctum program ids, supported LST count, and optional catalog-derived composition.
Wallet LST and INF balances found in SPL Token and Token-2022 accounts.
Sanctum Token Swap order preview for a supported input mint, output mint, amount, and slippage.

writeCapabilities.prepares: An inbox-bound PreparedAction that records input/output mints, human and raw amount, minimum output, slippage cap, fee cap, requested Sanctum sources, and quote facts. No reusable transaction is persisted.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A freshly refreshed Sanctum Token Swap transaction routed through Sanctum Router/Infinity sources.

writeCapabilities.prepares: An inbox-bound PreparedAction that deposits a supported LST/SOL token into Infinity for INF, with minimum INF and fee/slippage caps.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A freshly refreshed Sanctum Token Swap transaction using Infinity sources only.

writeCapabilities.prepares: An inbox-bound PreparedAction that redeems INF into a supported LST/SOL token, with minimum output and fee/slippage caps.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A freshly refreshed Sanctum Token Swap transaction using Infinity sources only.

writeCapabilities.prepares: An inbox-bound PreparedAction that stakes SOL into a Sanctum-supported LST through Router/Infinity sources.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A freshly refreshed Sanctum Token Swap transaction from wrapped SOL into the requested LST.

writeCapabilities.prepares: An inbox-bound PreparedAction that swaps or unstakes a Sanctum-supported LST into SOL, refusing delayed unstake routes unless explicitly allowed.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A freshly refreshed Sanctum Token Swap transaction from the requested LST into wrapped SOL/SOL.

actionPreparationNotes: Use the Sanctum Token Swap order endpoint for quotes and execution refreshes. Add/remove Infinity liquidity must request only the Inf source. LST swaps and SOL stake/unstake may request Inf plus SanctumRouter. Store quote facts and route constraints, not the transaction. Execution refreshes the order, repeats route/min-output/fee checks, asks the wallet to sign, and submits via Sanctum execute.
riskNotes: LST routes can include slippage, fees, pool liquidity constraints, stale APY data, and delayed unstake paths. Surface those facts as current-state facts, not guarantees. Missing API data is a warning or refusal, never a silent zero.
walletApprovalBoundary: Sanctum writes are prepare-only. The Sanctum API returns the transaction, the adapter refreshes and validates it at execution time, and only the wallet signs.
